verdict.rationale: Mercury Books documents automation features such as categorization rules created through Command, automatic categorization and reconciliation, and bill approval rules. Nothing in the evidence covers versioning those automations, reviewing changes to them, or rolling them back. Bill approval rules are a related control over payments, not version control or review of automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
